items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: Johnny Garland was a clarinet player.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, he's younger than me. Yeah. You see, at that time when, uh, when Eddie Garland, he, he, he was a member of his brother's band, Johnny Garland. Johnny Garland was a clarinet player. He's brother, he's brother of the clarinet. Now he, he had a band, he had a six-piece band, from uptown, see. Uh-huh. Now Eddie Garland, he couldn't, he couldn't pick, pick the bass, you know, he didn't know much about that. But playing with a bow. Yeah, he was good.
He was good with a bow.
